text.en: Recent feedback from pet owners includes serious complaints regarding grooming outcomes and breed-standard haircuts. One customer was distressed after a groomer shaved their Bichon Frise tail and body coat, while another noted an uneven haircut with mismatched lengths on paws and ears. Reviewers urge groomers to adhere closer to owner styling requests.

Dissatisfied clients report notable communication challenges when attempting to resolve grooming errors with management. Reviewers mention unreturned phone calls and unanswered emails regarding requested refunds and cut disputes. Owners emphasize that clear communication and proactive follow-up are essential when styling results fall short of expectations.

Pet owners acknowledge that individual groomers can be hardworking and pleasant during drop-off and pickup interactions. One reviewer noted that staff seemed gentle with their young puppy during the visit. Nonetheless, administrative delays and inconsistent styling execution have created friction for several patrons visiting this North Phoenix salon.

q.en: Does Puff & Fluff North32nd accept online appointment bookings?

a.en: Yes, clients can schedule appointments online through the Puff & Fluff booking portal for the North 32nd location.

q.en: What concerns have clients raised about grooming results?

a.en: Recent reviews report issues with uneven haircuts and unintended coat shaving on specific breeds such as Bichon Frises.

q.en: Are dogs of all breed sizes accepted for grooming?

a.en: Yes, the salon accommodates dogs across all weight tiers from toy breeds to large and giant dogs.

q.en: How do clients describe follow-up communication from the salon?

a.en: Reviewers note difficulty receiving timely responses from management when seeking resolution or refunds after disputed grooms.
